originals: All original files and exact private prefix map remain retained. Portable records are derivatives, not original receipt bytes, not re-signed receipts, and not a substitute for verification of the retained raw execution.
replacement: Apply each private literal prefix exactly once as a UTF-8 substring replacement, in the displayed order. JSON applies it to keys and string values, then sorted-key indent-2 UTF-8 serialization and one final newline. Non-JSON text is otherwise byte-preserved.
unchanged_values: Numbers, booleans, null, array order and opaque digest strings are unchanged. No arithmetic, status, acceptance or coverage values are rewritten.
